create_classification_evaluator: create a classification evaluator supporting binary, multi-class, and multi-label tasks with configurable loss and metrics
run_classification_evaluation: run classification evaluation on model parameters and return computed metrics including accuracy, f1, and loss
build_multilabel_evaluator: build a multilabel classification evaluator using sigmoid activation and custom loss functions
test_multihead_classification: test multihead classification evaluation with per-task head selection and per-class metrics
review_segmentation_to_classification: review segmentation-to-classification aggregation that converts (B,H,W,N) logits into (B,N) classification outputs
